text:
𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥 𝗪𝗜𝗡𝗦 𝗜𝗧! 🇿🇦

South Africa beat Australia by 176 runs in Cape Town to take the Test series 2-1.

Simon Harmer 6/16 bowled Australia out for 111 chasing 288 🔥

#Cricket #SAvAUS

facebook.caption:
𝗛𝗔𝗥𝗠𝗘𝗥 𝗡𝗘 𝗞𝗔𝗔𝗠 𝗧𝗔𝗠𝗔𝗔𝗠! 🇿🇦🔥

👉 South Africa ne Cape Town Test 176 runs se jeeta, series 2-1
👉 Australia ko 288 ka target mila, poori team 111 par out
👉 Simon Harmer ke 6/16, Rabada ke 3 early wickets
👉 Mulder 115 aur Rickelton 101 ne pehle base banaya

Kya ye Harmer ka best spell tha? Comment karo 👇
